scope: Portable assurance-as-code; not general AI engineering platform superiority

metrics.name: False-assurance miss rate
metrics.unit: seeded faults missed / seeded faults delivered

metrics.name: Portable-evidence loss rate
metrics.unit: required evidence fields lost / required evidence fields seeded

tasks.instruction: Run an eval whose provider delivers no usable samples. Record whether the product withholds the rate instead of presenting a reassuring pass or zero.
tasks.success: The fault is detected and the zero-usable denominator is explicit.

tasks.instruction: Run a multi-step workflow whose final output succeeds after an intermediate handoff is left unchecked. Record whether the product distinguishes final success from handoff verification.
tasks.success: The unchecked handoff is represented and final success is not promoted to end-to-end verification.

tasks.instruction: Run an evaluation with missing usage or price evidence. Record whether the product labels cost as not checked instead of reporting a fabricated value.
tasks.success: Missing cost evidence remains visibly unverified.

tasks.instruction: Use a judge without calibration evidence and inspect the resulting assurance report.
tasks.success: The report states the calibration gap beside the judge result.

tasks.instruction: Seed eval, control, provenance, lifecycle, and unknown-extension fields; use the product's supported export/import path; then review the result offline.
tasks.success: Every required field is preserved or an explicit loss warning identifies it.

tasks.instruction: From a clean environment, clone the seeded repository, make the supplied change, demonstrate a failing eval, fix the artifact, and produce reviewed passing evidence.
tasks.success: A reviewer can trace the change from red to green using retained artifacts within the 45-minute timebox.
